description: This file implements lazy freeing mechanisms for Redis objects, including functions for asynchronously freeing objects, databases, and cluster slot mappings, as well as tracking pending free objects.

methods.name: lazyfreeGetPendingObjectsCount
methods.description: Returns the number of objects pending to be freed.

methods.name: dbAsyncDelete
methods.description: Deletes a key from the database asynchronously, possibly adding the object to a lazy free list.

methods.name: freeObjAsync
methods.description: Frees an object asynchronously if it exceeds the effort threshold.

methods.name: emptyDbAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously empties a Redis database, scheduling old hash tables for lazy freeing.

methods.name: slotToKeyFlushAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously clears the cluster slot-to-key mapping, scheduling old mapping for lazy freeing.

methods.name: lazyfreeFreeObjectFromBioThread
methods.description: Releases an object from the lazyfree thread, decrementing reference count.

methods.name: lazyfreeFreeDatabaseFromBioThread
methods.description: Releases a database from the lazyfree thread, freeing associated dictionaries.

methods.name: lazyfreeFreeSlotsMapFromBioThread
methods.description: Releases a cluster slot-to-key mapping from the lazyfree thread.
